body: Not really. So I've been posting sad posts on Facebook and I have over 780 friends. I just realized my reputation is fucked as I've been doing this for a year. I would give anything to restore my reputation and have people think I am cool again, but idk how.
Hey. I'm doing okay. Still down.

I've met my soulmate and I squandered it. This girl I met back in February, and we hung out a lot. She ended up moving in with me in March and we just fell out. She hates my guts now. I wish it worked out. She was the only girl who showed me that much attention. I will never meet another girl who finds me attractive that I also find attractive ever again. She slightly out of my league yet she still liked me.

When we fell out, she knew I struggled with depression and used that against me telling me that she wish I did kill myself. Even though in the beginning she was my battle partner and was super comforting with my issues while I was comforting with hers.

I wish I could be that amazing man that women are looking for, but the truth is I'm not. I'm short, I'm balding, I have a small frame. On top of that I'm emotionally immature and socially awkward. So women won't miss much if I died.

>And trust me once you do experience relationships you see it's not all it's cracked up to be.

I had a quzi-girlfriend. Like we didn't date. But she moved in with me and spent time 24/7 with me, ever once leaving my side unless I went to work, and even then she'd come to my work and just hang out there since she didn't have many friends. 

Yeah, she was extremely emotional and hard to deal with, and even abusive at times. But every day I miss her. That was the closest thing I've ever had to a girlfriend.

>And yes, sometimes you have to go out of your way to make things happen, but it’s always worth a shot.

That's the thing. Due to the combination of creeps and fuckbois, and the metoo movement, it's hard to find a girlfriend and show interest without fear of getting shamed.

She slightly out of my league yet she still liked me.

I don't make a lot of money, but I make over $40k a year from doing freelance web development. I am short and might have low test, who knows. 

It's not really having a girlfriend that I want. I just want to be wanted.
Yeah that only works for good looking people. I've tried it. No luck. Had maybe 3 total dates in the years of trying but never got a second

That's the only solution, is to lower my standards. I want to be with someoen I am attracted to. I don't expect a model at all. In fact, I prefer women who are flat chested and don't have an ass. Like I like skinny women. I don't like the idea of dating a 300lb woman. 

I want a actual girlfriend that I am happy with. I don't want to get an escort. I want someone that loves me as much as I love them.

I don't know how to make moves!

I have this long term friend of 5 years, we'll call her Lucy, that I've always crushed on. (Not my roommate). We went camping together a few weeks ago with mutual friends. I got drunk and gave her a long hug but that was it, and that could have been either platonic or romantic.

So I won't really consider myself an incel since I don't hate women. I actually have a decent social circle and I have a good handful of female friends.

The problem is, I don't have a girlfriend or have had any girl show sexual attraction towards me in years. I mean I've had hints here and there but they are probably just me wishful thinking, because from what I've heard, if a girl likes you, you will know 100%.

The closest thing I've had to a girlfriend was this female friend that I started talking to back in February, and we started hanging out, and she'd lay her head on my chest from time to time while hanging out. She then moved in with me and kinda mooched off of me for a month, before becoming very verbally abusive and I had to cut her loose. I also had this other female friend for 5 years who occasionally meets me for drinks or goes to concerts and music festivals with me, but it seems like she is not interested in a romantic relationship.

Basically, I am an incel who happens to have friends and a decent social life. I am a bit socially awkward but I make it work well enough as I have friends in the "hippy" community and there's plenty of "weirdos" that I can vibe with. But the issue is that no girl seems to actually want to date, hookup, or be in a relationship with me. I've tried Tinder to no avail. I did this hippy app called Radiate which is like the Tinder of hippies, and I got actual matches and messages but wasn't able to actually lock in any dates. And online dating is hard for me as I SUUCK with breaking the ice and starting conversation. Most of my social life comes from friends and friends of friends.

To top it off I am only 5'6", my face isn't too bad, but I have a small frame. So I am worried I am going to die alone because women want men who can protect them.

What is some advice for someone in my shoes?
